text:
olivia: Quick async check — kernel perf sprint status update pls. TL;DR: where are we on the KV eviction PR, continuous-batching perf numbers, and any CRs blocked by infra? I'm trying to assemble the mid-sprint milestone note for PM. Ping owners and call out any dependencies.

randal: KV eviction PR #4821 is in review, comments addressed, waiting on kevin for perf regression signoff. local microbench shows ~9% median latency improvement when eviction tuned, but tail spikes still around 95th.

kevin: ack. running end-to-end on canary today. saw a regression in sequence reuse path — digging, likely a race in cache warmup. I pushed a small fix to randal's branch (commented inline). If CI passes I'll approve.

anya: continuous batching telemetry looks good for short sequences. End-to-end token throughput up ~18% at 128 seq, but for 1k sequences headroom reduced. Need to decide if we keep aggressive batching for the mixed workload or limit to <512 for low-latency tier.

devon: infra note — canary cluster had one node with outdated driver (nvidia 525 vs 535) which caused a fallback to CPU kernel for a small slice. Fixed and reimaged at 10:22am. infra-bot shows no more mismatches.

infra-bot: [canary-reimage] Node gpu-05 reimaged, driver updated to 535.3. Canary rolling restart started.

randal: thanks devon. re-running the full load repro with correct drivers, will report numbers here.

kevin: CI is green except one flaky test: tests/runtime/cache_warmup_test::test_eviction_race. Local reproducer attached in PR comment. @olivia can you add as dependency for the release note that kernel team will follow up on flake? want to avoid shipping regressions.

olivia: noted — I'll call out "flaky eviction race under high-concurrency" as a risk in the milestone doc. If you can post the reproducer link that helps product triage.

randal: reproducer link: https://ci.internal/rep/evict-repro-1809 — failing when concurrency > 120 and sequences > 800. Working on a lock-free guard fix.

anya: one more: batching change requires a small change in the router config to limit batch size per model variant. I'll submit a tiny console config PR and tag devon for rollout window.

devon: happy to schedule the change. prefer rollout during low traffic window 02:00-04:00 PT, unless you need it earlier.

kevin: quick ask — can we get explicit owner mapping for these pieces? propose: randal -> KV eviction & prefetch hooks, anya -> batching alg and router knobs, kevin -> perf infra & tests, devon -> canary/driver infra. Others OK with that?

olivia: yes, that mapping works. I'll update the sprint board owners. Add to the milestone: "owner and blocker" table.

randal: blocker for my PR is the eviction race and the test flake. ETA for fix: EOD tomorrow if tests behave.

anya: blocker for broader rollout is the router change + A/B config; I'll draft the config PR and a short rollback plan.

devon: infra blocker cleared (driver fixed). Only remaining is scheduling the config change window with oncall — I'll ping ops.

kevin: plan for approval: once randal's fix merged and canary shows no tail regressions for 6 hours, I'll sign off. If we see >5% tail increase we revert.

olivia: perfect. Action items: randal -> merge fix and link CI reproducer; anya -> config PR + rollback plan; kevin -> perf signoff after 6h canary; devon -> schedule rollout window w/ops. I'll add these to the milestone doc and send to PM by EOD.

devon: ping on ops schedule: ops says 02:30 PT window is open tomorrow.

randal: merging small fix now, will update thread with merge sha.

ci-bot: Build #7824 for PR #4821 succeeded. All checks passed.

randal: merged sha: ab12f3c. starting canary run.

kevin: seeing canary steady at +10% throughput and 6% lower median latency, tail at +1% (within threshold). I'll monitor overnight and update tomorrow morning.

olivia: thanks everyone. If any new blockers pop up, drop them here. Otherwise I'll finalize the milestone note and mark owners. :thumbsup:
